title: I made a website for sharing working configs
symptom: The issue is not a problem report but an announcement of a website for sharing working/broken configurations for xDrip+ after Android updates. The author expresses fear of Android updates breaking xDrip+ functionality.
evidence_quote: I am always afraid of installing android updates since they broke the xdrip+ app functionality a few times in the past. I made a website where we can share working/broken configurations.
